chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Paradise is forbidden for those who oppress the members of my Household, and for those who fight them, and for the one who assists them, and for those who insult them. Those are the ones who will have no share of any good in the Hereafter; God will speak to them, but will not look upon them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them, and they will have a painful punishment.
ai.seo_question: Who is forbidden from entering Paradise according to the Prophet's tradition regarding the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* establishes the prohibition of Paradise for those who wrong the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing their unique spiritual status. It highlights the severe eschatological consequences, including divine silence and the withholding of purification, which underscores the Shia doctrine of the infallibility and elevated rank of the Prophet's Household.
